findings.evidence: Add a legend when more than one line style appears is a generic diagramming habit the model already applies.
findings.fix: Drop that sentence from references/layout-guidelines.md section 2 and add a row to docs/audit/recovery/draw-io/record.md; keep the dashed/solid/dotted style fragments and the accessibility second-cue rule.

findings.evidence: The Arrows table never says which side is exitX=0 versus exitX=1, so the agent still guesses the gutter route.
findings.fix: Add one sentence under the Arrows table: exitX=0 is the left edge, 1 the right, exitY=0 the top, 1 the bottom; pick the side that faces the other end.

findings.evidence: Gotchas never says an mxCell id must be unique, so a copied skeleton silently breaks source and target.
findings.fix: Add a Gotchas item: NEVER reuse an mxCell id, because source and target bind to the first cell with that id and the edge attaches to the wrong node.

findings.evidence: Section 5 only says to use the search script, with no scenario and no file to skip.
findings.fix: Replace that section with: run scripts/find_aws_icon.py first; read this file only when it exits 1 or the Service line is marked [unverified]; do not load it for a non-AWS diagram.

findings.evidence: pre-commit language is a menu: use unsupported on 4.4.0 or newer and keep system for older versions, with no way to tell which is installed.
findings.fix: Default the hook to language: unsupported, and say to use system only when pre-commit --version prints below 4.4.0.

findings.evidence: Six prompts cover creation, AWS icons, grouping and compressed XML, but none asserts the page-versus-container ancestor rule or the three hang causes.
findings.fix: Add one eval whose connector spans two containers and must keep parent="1", and one whose drawio --version hangs and must follow the three causes in Export.

findings.evidence: The vendor default is named but the sentence says it is not reproduced, so the agent cannot apply it.
findings.fix: Put the fragment in the instruction: style ends with labelBackgroundColor=default;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=page; so the label background follows the page.

findings.evidence: The catalog says 92 names are in neither source and 84 of them are marked [unverified], but the file marks 85 rows.
findings.fix: Recount the [unverified] rows against the palette check and correct 84 or 92 so the intro matches the table.
